description_en: Invokes this operation to query the details of a specified over-the-air update upgrade package, including the name, type, and status of the package
description_zh: 调用该接口查询指定OTA升级包的详细信息，包括升级包的名称、类型、状态等
kebab_example: aliyun iot query-ota-firmware --iot-instance-id iot_instc_pu0000_c0-v6400000000 --firmware-id s8SSHiKjpBfrM3BSN0z8030000 --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: QueryOTAFirmware

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.

><notice>
- If this parameter is available, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.
- If the **Overview** page or the ID is not available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

></notice>

For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的**实例概览**页面，查看当前实例的**ID**。

><notice>
- 若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
- 若无**实例概览**页面或ID值，则无需传入。

></notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The over-the-air update upgrade package ID, which is the unique identity of the upgrade package.

The over-the-air update upgrade package ID is one of the parameters returned when you invoke https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/147311.html to create an upgrade package.

You can invoke https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/147450.html to view the ID from the response parameters
parameters.help_zh:
OTA升级包ID，升级包的唯一标识符。

OTA升级包ID是调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/147311.html创建升级包时，返回的参数之一。

可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/147450.html，从返回参数中查看
parameters.name: firmware_id
